name: Website Login with Playwright
description: Navigate to a website, log in with credentials, and verify the dashboard loads. Uses Playwright for browser automation.
context_rules: Never store real passwords in workflow variables. Always close the browser when done.

steps.name: Navigate to login page
steps.description: Open the target website in a headless browser
steps.instruction: Open a Chromium browser and navigate to https://example.com/login. Wait for the page to fully load.
steps.verification: Login form is visible with username and password fields

steps.name: Fill in credentials and login
steps.description: Enter username and password, then submit the login form
steps.instruction: Fill in the username field with the value from {{username}} and the password field with {{password}}, then click the login/submit button. Wait for navigation to complete.
steps.verification: URL changes away from /login and no error messages are visible

steps.name: Verify dashboard loaded
steps.description: Take a screenshot and confirm the dashboard is accessible
steps.instruction: Take a screenshot of the current page. Verify that the dashboard or main navigation is visible and there are no error messages. Close the browser.
steps.verification: Dashboard heading or navigation menu is visible. No 'error' or 'unauthorized' text on page.
